actions.action: Push finger 2-3 inches into soil to check moisture
If soil is wet, hold off watering and let it dry out
Water thoroughly until it drains, then empty saucer
Water when top inch or two is dry (ongoing)
Cut fully brown or yellow leaves at the base
Move plant to bright indirect light away from heaters and drafts
Group plants or set up a pebble tray for humidity
If soil stays wet or roots are mushy, repot into fresh well-draining mix and check roots

reason: The answer makes underwatering its main diagnosis and leads with a thorough soak and trimming the yellow leaves, which is the fix that worked; its overwatering cautions are safeguarded by soil checks, so nothing in it is harmful.
